catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.logicalSeriesDescription: Group two or more series from the same library under one title. Their files, volumes and progress will be preserved.
catalog.logicalSeriesOrderHelp: Assign a unique position to each series. Volumes retain their order within each one.
catalog.logicalSeriesInvalid: Enter a title and select at least two series with unique positive integer positions.
catalog.logicalSeriesUnavailable: Could not create the logical series. Refresh the page and check that the series are still available.
catalog.logicalSeriesDeleteSure: Only the grouping will be removed. Physical series will appear separately again and keep their files and progress.
catalog.logicalSeriesUpdateUnavailable: Could not update the logical series. Refresh the page and check that the series are still available.
catalog.comicInfoDescription: Edit this volume’s XML. Saving updates the library file and its metadata in Bunko.
catalog.comicInfoLoadError: Could not read the XML from the archive.
catalog.comicInfoInvalidXml: Invalid XML. Check the ComicInfo structure and field values.
catalog.comicInfoConflict: The file has changed since you opened it. Close and reopen the editor to load the current version.
catalog.comicInfoDuplicateXml: The archive contains multiple ComicInfo.xml files. Remove the duplicates before editing.
catalog.comicInfoSyncError: Could not update the database. The archive was restored to its previous version.
catalog.comicInfoRestoreError: Could not synchronize the database or restore the archive. Rescan the volume to synchronize its metadata.
catalog.comicInfoUnauthorized: You do not have permission to edit metadata.
catalog.comicInfoUnsupportedArchive: This archive cannot be edited because it is protected, signed, locked, or split into multiple volumes. The archive was not changed.
